references.title: Catalyst design by interpolation in the periodic table: Bimetallic ammonia synthesis catalysts
references.author_metadata_note: Use S. Bahn as printed by ACS; the DTU institutional record expands his name to Sune Rastad Bahn.
references.access_scope: ACS indexed publisher bibliographic record and opened DTU institutional bibliographic record. Full article body was not accessible and was not read. Experimental linkage or quantitative catalyst results were not independently verified.
references.supports: The publication addresses periodic-table interpolation in bimetallic ammonia-synthesis catalyst design; bibliography and topic only.
references.aps_text: C. J. H. Jacobsen, S. Dahl, B. S. Clausen, S. Bahn, A. Logadottir, and J. K. Nørskov, Catalyst design by interpolation in the periodic table: Bimetallic ammonia synthesis catalysts, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 123, 8404–8405 (2001).

references.title: A climbing image nudged elastic band method for finding saddle points and minimum energy paths
references.access_scope: Original four-page article read, including abstract, introduction, harmonic transition-state rate expression, DFT applications, NEB/CI-NEB procedure, variable springs and figure captions. Author-hosted PDF retrieved; university course copy also inspected.
references.supports: CI-NEB searches nuclear-coordinate paths for saddle points; reported applications use plane-wave DFT for CH4 dissociation on Ir(111) and H2 on Si(100). No new calculation was reproduced.
references.aps_text: G. Henkelman, B. P. Uberuaga, and H. Jónsson, A climbing image nudged elastic band method for finding saddle points and minimum energy paths, J. Chem. Phys. 113, 9901–9904 (2000).

references.title: Quantum chemistry calculations on a trapped-ion quantum simulator
references.author_metadata_note: Exact printed given names begin Cornelius Hempel and Christine Maier. All 13 authors are retained.
references.access_scope: Publisher abstract, popular summary and bibliographic record; published PDF abstract, introduction and fixed-nuclei electronic-structure/mapping discussion were read. The complete 22-page article was not read.
references.supports: Actual trapped-calcium-ion VQE demonstration for H2 and LiH using up to four qubits and discussion of measurement noise/mitigation. It does not establish the fictional catalyst barrier, accuracy, runtime or a quantum advantage.
references.aps_text: C. Hempel, C. Maier, J. Romero, J. McClean, T. Monz, H. Shen, P. Jurcevic, B. P. Lanyon, P. Love, R. Babbush, A. Aspuru-Guzik, R. Blatt, and C. F. Roos, Quantum chemistry calculations on a trapped-ion quantum simulator, Phys. Rev. X 8, 031022 (2018).
